segments.en: Hello.
Hi.
Where are you from?
Vijayawada. Where are you from?
I am from Bhimavaram.
Oh my god.
Why are you saying that?
Bhimavaram girls are very intelligent and talented. I cannot talk to them, that is why.
Thinking like that is wrong. I don't have that much intelligence or talent.
Oh my god, you are very intelligent, Bhimavaram girl.
Okay, leave it. Whether I am intelligent or not, accept the video call, you will know.
No, I don't want to. We can talk on this app, right?
What?
Talk on this app.
I am saying on this app, I asked you to accept the video call.
I don't have the video call option on this app.
Why wouldn't you have it? Click on it, a green button will appear, turn it on.
No, I don't have that option, I didn't take it.
You don't need to take that option, it is automatically there for everyone.
No, I am not interested in that.
If you say that, it is enough. Why say there is no option?
My phone is a keypad phone, some small Samsung phone from a long time ago.
Then, if it is a small keypad phone, how did you install this app? Tell me.
Ah, the app, it is not a keypad phone, it is a small Samsung phone.
The camera on it doesn't work properly, that is why I don't do video calls.
Tell me that, at least.
You said video calls cannot be done.
I am just a small employee.
How much is your salary?
My salary is 12,000.
Then when it is so hard, why download this app?
Some friend of mine, he installed it without me knowing.
Okay, let's talk for a while, for fun. Video call is happening, right?
Video call is also good, right?
No, I don't have video calls. Audio calls, we are talking well now, right?
Okay, tell me.
How old are you?
How old are you?
I am 22.
There should be a limit to lying, at least.
Why?
Listening to your voice, you sound like a 25 or 26-year-old person. You are saying 22 years old, are we sitting here with bangles on?
Don't look for logic. You should enjoy the happiness that comes. Now, I have a sore throat and fever for two days.
I am not getting sleep, my legs are tired. I came on the app to have fun. That is it, if you want to talk, talk, if it is hard, you can cut it.
I am not saying that. Your voice sounds like you are 24 or 25 years old. But the age you are saying is not syncing, okay?
I am telling you, I have had a fever and sore throat for two days. I am not getting sleep, just having fun.
However much you have a cold, however much fever you have, there will be some change in the voice, but is there too much change? Tell me.
Okay, let's talk for a while for fun.
Okay, tell me, what?
How much is your age?
My age is 20.
Okay. What is your bra size?
I didn't come here for that purpose, I came to talk in a friendly way. If you are interested in talking in a friendly way, talk, otherwise no.
Okay, if that is what you say.
That is it, right?
You felt like Bhimavaram, that is it.
That much should be there for Bhimavaram girls.
There is, there is.
I have been saying that for a long time. Today I am seeing it, that is it.
What did you see? What did you hear?
You are very tech-savvy.
